meta.title: Optimize TrimStackTrace to use spans instead of Regex.Split
meta.body_summary: Replace Regex.Split in TrimStackTrace with a span-based loop to reduce allocations and overhead, with conditional compilation for .NET 6+ and unit tests.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot span optimization was technically sound but closed after maintainers decided TrimStackTrace should be removed in v4, making the PR obsolete.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 184 changed lines across 2 files, this is a small, focused performance optimization. It was closed—not merged—due to maintainer decision to remove the target method in v4 rather than optimize it, despite technical soundness.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainers discussed that TrimStackTrace should be removed altogether in v4, because .NET 6+ already provides StackTraceHiddenAttribute, making the method unnecessary. The PR was closed in favor of this plan.
review_details.performance_claim: Span-based splitting eliminates regex overhead and reduces allocations for TrimStackTrace.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer Evangelink agreed with closing in favor of removing the method in v4, after discussion about StackTraceHiddenAttribute.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent produced a technically valid optimization but lacked knowledge of project roadmap (method planned for removal in v4); also required conditional compilation to handle existing multi-targeting.

detection_detail.code_reading: Evangelink identified multi-target compatibility issue; Youssef1313 suggested removing the method entirely, recalling StackTraceHiddenAttribute for .NET 6+.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or profiling evidence provided; only narrative performance claims.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed after maintainer discussion without a fix-in-PR cycle; decision to remove the method in v4.

core_change_summary.description: Replaced Regex.Split with a span-based loop in ExceptionHelper.TrimStackTrace to avoid string[] allocation; added conditional compilation for .NET 6+; added unit tests for behavior parity.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: span-based optimization and unit tests.
Added conditional compilation for .NET 6+ target per review.
After discussion, PR closed due to plans to remove TrimStackTrace in v4.

review_signals.summary: Requested span usage only for .NET 6+ due to multi-targeting.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot added conditional compilation in subsequent commit.

review_signals.summary: Confirmed addition of conditional compilation for net6+ while keeping original for older targets.
Suggested removing TrimStackTrace entirely in v4, citing StackTraceHiddenAttribute for .NET 6+.
Explained that StackTraceHiddenAttribute is already available for hiding stack frames.
Agreed to close the PR in favor of removal in v4.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with span-based optimization.
Youssef1313 suggested removing method in v4; Evangelink agreed.
